title: Crouching is Dangerous!
description: you will get damage when you crouching
body:
# Crouching is Dangerous

That mod will make your game harder. Adding new mechanic which is damaging player when he's crouching. Makes game a lot more challanging.

Damage is **InWall type** what means your protection IV wont save you from that.

will you beat game without crouching?

you can use mod inside modpacks.

Mod Created with java
(It's my first java mod with ''if'' so it may contain bugs)
